name: harness-ops
description: Claude Code operations: audit-skill-visibility (skills the listing budget hides), inventory (every invocable surface), audit-install-state, audit-performance (slowness), audit-mod-posture (mods and the guard), audit-native-overlap (skills duplicating built-ins), observability (reports from session-telemetry's records), known-issues, changelog, behavior-probes, prerequisites, check, machine-profile, plugins (update the fleet), lanes (background loop sessions), setup.

registry_dir.title: Known-issues registry directory
registry_dir.description: Project-relative directory holding the known-issues registry (registry.json). Unset: the plugin data directory, ${CLAUDE_PLUGIN_DATA}. A repository's registry_dir in harness-ops.yaml beats this option. Absolute, drive, UNC, traversal, and escaping-symlink paths are invalid.

install_new.title: New-plugin install policy
install_new.description: Sync action for catalog plugins not yet installed. ask (default) offers them in AskUserQuestion chunks, at most 4 options per question and 4 questions per call; a chunk of 1 is a single-select Install/Skip question. Each pick is installed and enabled. all installs every one; none only reports them.

directory_source_pull.title: Directory-source pull
directory_source_pull.description: Sync action for a directory marketplace whose git checkout is clean, on a branch with an upstream, and only behind it. ask (default) offers to run git pull --ff-only and continues the sync with the refreshed catalog; never only reports the command. An autonomous session never asks or pulls.

quiet_auto_update_marketplaces.title: Marketplaces without the autoUpdate hint
quiet_auto_update_marketplaces.description: Comma-separated marketplace names whose sync report shows autoUpdate: off without the suggestion to enable it. Empty, the default, keeps the suggestion for every marketplace with autoUpdate off.

update_other_paths.title: Update other paths on sync
update_other_paths.description: Whether sync also updates the outdated project and local plugin records of every other present path on this machine, one CLI call per record. Off (the default), sync reports how many it left and how to update them.

lane_app_slug.title: Lane GitHub app slug
lane_app_slug.description: Slug of the GitHub App whose installation token the lanes run gh under, passed as --app-slug to the restart consumer and the telemetry upsert so they read the lanes' own telemetry. Needed only under an App token. Absent: the identity resolves from gh api user. Must match ^[a-z0-9][a-z0-9-]*$.
